notes: CDER CGMP letter for sterile injectable manufacturing: aseptic-processing design flaws revealed by deficient smoke studies, media fills that failed to simulate worst-case intervention durations, unexplained surface discoloration near a filling line, and untimely investigation of environmental-monitoring excursions (adverse trend of mold recoveries on personnel) and a visible-particulate contamination investigation. Organisms are omitted from the list because only 'mold' (no genus-species) is named, not a specific organism. Products are redacted as (b)(4) throughout. Facility is in Kirkland, Quebec, Canada.
